experimental.title: Experimental Features
experimental.subtitle: Advanced options to improve performance. Use them only if you know what you are doing.

streamingBackup.title: Full Streaming Backup (no temporary .tar)
streamingBackup.desc: Uploads the full backup without writing the .tar file to disk. May speed up large games. In this mode, progress doesn't show percentages and "Pause/Resume" is not supported.

dryRun.title: Dry Run Mode (streaming without uploading to cloud)
dryRun.desc: Generates the backup in streaming and measures performance, but does not create objects in the cloud. Only for local testing; the backup is not saved in S3.

compression.title: Packaged Backup Compression (Zstd)
compression.desc: Only applies to full backup in streaming mode (including dry run mode): the stream packages with Zstd before uploading. If streaming is disabled, the classic backup remains a .tar without external Zstd compression.
compression.debounceHint: The disk value updates after you stop dragging for a moment (debounce). "Restore" saves instantly.
compression.lowLevelsDesc: less CPU and shorter backup time; upload finishes sooner. Ideal if you prioritize speed and stability.
compression.highLevelsDesc: smaller file in the cloud and less bandwidth; much slower and may heat up the device during packaging.
compression.gameDataHint: Many games already contain compressed data (e.g., .pak, textures); in those cases, increasing the level yields little size reduction for a lot of time.

benchmark.title: Test Streaming Compression (Dry-Run)
benchmark.desc: Simulates real-time TAR packaging and compression to measure speed and exact space saved without uploading to the cloud.
benchmark.noGames: Add at least one game to your library to test compression.

gameMode.title: Game Mode
gameMode.subtitle: Reduces contention with your games: less network and disk usage by SaveCloud, and a more favorable energy profile if supported. Does not replace GPU drivers or guarantee higher FPS on corporate or restricted systems.
gameMode.pauseTrafficDesc: Pauses active multipart uploads (if any), ongoing SaveCloud torrents, and downloads from sources with Running status until exiting the mode.
gameMode.powerProfileWin: Activates the Windows «High performance» power plan with powercfg (if supported by system).
gameMode.powerProfileOther: On macOS it can use caffeinate if available. On some Linux desktops it attempts «powerprofilesctl set performance» (must be in PATH).
gameMode.gameBar: Reduce Xbox Game DVR overhead (Windows only)
gameMode.gameBarDesc: Optional: adjusts AppCaptureEnabled under HKCU to reduce recording/background related to Game Bar. Reverted when game mode is disabled.
gameMode.cpuPriorityDesc: After a few seconds (~process monitor interval), only if the game's executable name (.exe) matches what is configured for it in the library — for example re9.exe. If it does not match, SaveCloud will not touch the process. On Windows, logs will show «[CpuBoost] Elevated priority…» or a warning if access was denied. Independent of the «Game Mode» switch.

performance.title: Low performance mode
performance.subtitle: Disables interface transitions, blur visual effects, automatic videos in catalog/profiles, and interactive WebGL components. Recommended for integrated GPUs, laptops on battery, or legacy PCs.

gpuAcceleration.title: Disable hardware acceleration
gpuAcceleration.subtitle: Disables GPU usage for rendering the interface. Can solve flickering, black screen issues, or graphics driver incompatibility.
gpuAcceleration.warning: * Requires restarting the application to apply changes.

developer.title: Developer mode
developer.desc: Saved in the active profile. In the installed app, it unlocks the webview inspector (DevTools), shortcuts like F12 / Ctrl+Shift+I, and the context menu; it also displays plugin tools (Lua SDK, logs).
developer.viteInfo: In vite, the inspector is usually already available; the switch mostly affects production builds and the settings saved in the profile.

about.heroSubtitle: Your infrastructure, your rules. Sync game saves in your own cloud, download titles from the Steam catalog, and share it with whoever you want.
about.whatIsP1: SaveCloud is an open source and self-hosted app that syncs your game saves with your own AWS cloud, and includes an integrated store with the Steam catalog to download games via torrent.
about.whatIsP2: Unlike other services, you deploy and control the entire infrastructure. We give you the scripts needed to have your instance ready in minutes.

01.title: Your own cloud
01.description: Deploy your personal infrastructure on AWS. You control your data, without relying on third-party services.

02.title: 100% private
02.description: Your saves are stored in your own AWS account. No one else has access to your files.

03.title: Invite your friends
03.description: Once deployed, share your instance with friends. They only need the credentials you generate.

04.title: Instant sync
04.description: Upload and download saves with one click. Automatic detection of changes in your save files.

about.storeDesc: Access the full Steam catalog from the app. Find the game you want and download it directly via torrent, without leaving SaveCloud. Once installed, your saves sync automatically in your cloud.

01.title: Full Steam catalog
01.description: Browse the official Steam catalog directly from the app. Search, discover, and view information for any game without leaving SaveCloud.

02.title: Torrent download
02.description: Download games directly from the store using torrents, similar to Hydra Launcher. Native integration with the torrent client for a smooth experience.

03.title: Detailed pages
03.description: Screenshots, descriptions, reviews, and system requirements fetched directly from Steam for each available title.

04.title: Manage from one place
04.description: Once downloaded, SaveCloud automatically syncs your saves in the cloud. Download and save, all in the same app.

about.inspirationP1: SaveCloud was born inspired by Hydra Launcher, the popular open source client that combines a game catalog with torrent downloads. We took that idea and went one step further: besides downloading games, SaveCloud lets you sync and back up your saves on your own AWS infrastructure, giving you full control over your data.
about.inspirationP2: If you already use Hydra Launcher, SaveCloud is the perfect complement: same open access philosophy, with the private cloud layer that was always missing.
about.deploySubtitle: You only need an AWS account and two commands.
about.deployHint: The process automatically generates all credentials needed to connect.

benefits.01: No subscription costs — you only pay for what you use on AWS

about.shareDesc: Once your instance is deployed, you can invite friends to use it. They only need the credentials generated by the deploy. Perfect for groups that want to share resources and costs.

files.title: Your files are yours
files.desc: Stored in your own AWS account

about.footerTagline: Open Source · Self-Hosted · Made for gamers
